name: application-textareas
title: Textareas
description: Multi-line text input components for free-form user input in forms, with base, action-inside, and action-outside variants for comment boxes, message composers, and feedback fields.
useWhen: Accepting multi-line free-form text such as comments, messages, descriptions, or feedback.
The expected input is longer than a single line — product descriptions, support ticket details, or bio fields.
An action button (submit, attach, emoji) is embedded inside or directly below the text input area.
avoidWhen: A single line of text is sufficient — use a standard text <input> instead.
The field expects structured data like a date, number, or selection — use the appropriate specialized input.
Rich text formatting is required — use a rich text editor instead of a plain textarea.
responsiveBehavior: Textareas fill their container width. Height is set with rows attribute or a min-height class; auto-resize on input is a JavaScript enhancement not included by default.
accessibility: Every textarea must have an associated <label> linked by for/id or wrapped around the element.
Provide a character count or remaining-characters indicator when there is a maximum length.
Error states must be communicated via aria-describedby pointing to an error message element, not color alone.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Standard multi-line textarea with a visible label and placeholder — the default for comment boxes, description fields, and feedback forms.
accessibility: Requires a linked <label>; placeholder text is not a substitute for the label.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Standard textarea adapted for dark application surfaces with dark input background and light label and placeholder.
accessibility: Placeholder text and input text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark textarea backgrounds.

variants.title: Actions inside
variants.description: Textarea with action buttons (such as submit or attach) positioned inside the input area at the bottom edge — used for chat composers and inline reply forms.
accessibility: Action buttons inside the textarea must be focusable and reachable by keyboard in document order after the textarea.

variants.title: Actions inside (Dark)
variants.description: In-field action button textarea adapted for dark surfaces, with action button colors legible on dark input backgrounds.
accessibility: Action button icons inside the dark textarea must meet contrast requirements against the dark input background.

variants.title: Actions outside
variants.description: Textarea with action buttons positioned below or beside the field — a toolbar-below layout for post composers, note editors, or support ticket forms.
accessibility: Buttons below the textarea are in natural DOM order and are keyboard-accessible without special ARIA.

variants.title: Actions outside (Dark)
variants.description: External action button textarea adapted for dark surfaces, keeping the action toolbar legible below or beside the dark input.
accessibility: Action button text and icon colors in the external toolbar must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.
